en.headline: Observatory issues Very Hot Weather Warning on Saturday morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 8.40am, expecting very hot weather today with a high of about 33 degrees and brief sunshine after early showers.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 8.40am on Saturday, saying very hot weather was expected in Hong Kong today. The government also posted a matching notice at 8.42am.

The Observatory's forecast called for a mainly cloudy Saturday with a few showers, isolated thunderstorms at first, then brief sunshine and heat, with a high of about 33 degrees and light to moderate west to southwesterly winds. About 20 millimetres of rain was recorded this morning over eastern Hong Kong Island and Cheung Chau.

The Observatory said elderly people, pregnant women, infants and children, and those with chronic illnesses such as heart disease or high blood pressure are more vulnerable to heat stroke. It advised people working or exercising outdoors to drink more water, avoid over-exertion, rest in the shade if unwell, and follow the Labour Department's guidance on preventing heat stroke at work.

The Department of Health separately reminded the public that heat stroke has led to more than 200 hospital admissions a year in Hong Kong over the past five years, with a small number of deaths mainly between May and September. Sunday and Monday are expected to remain unsettled with further showers and thunderstorms.

zh.headline: 天文台周六早上發出酷熱天氣警告
zh.dek: 天文台今早8時40分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日酷熱，最高氣溫約33度，早上有驟雨後日間短暫有陽光。
body: 香港天文台周六上午8時40分發出酷熱天氣警告，表示預料本港今日天氣酷熱。政府亦於上午8時42分發出相應公布。
天文台預測今日大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，初時局部地區有雷暴，日間短暫時間有陽光及酷熱，最高氣溫約33度，吹輕微至和緩西至西南風。今早港島東及長洲錄得約20毫米雨量。
天文台表示，長者、孕婦、嬰幼兒，以及患有心臟病或高血壓等長期病患的人士較易中暑。在戶外工作或活動時應多喝水、避免過度勞累，不適應盡快到陰涼處休息，並參考勞工處預防工作時中暑指引。
衞生署另提醒，過去五年本港每年平均有逾200宗中暑入院個案，死亡個案主要集中在5月至9月。展望明日及星期一天氣不穩定，仍有驟雨及雷暴。
